## Variant

- Variant ID: `PKV-...`
- Parent variant: `PKV-CANONICAL` or another registered ancestor
- Fork/repository:
- Implementation commit:
- Homepage/demo:

## Mutation summary

What changed visually, technically, narratively, educationally, or culturally?

## Preserved invariants

Check at least three that remain explicit:

- [ ] Recover. Don't amplify.
- [ ] Visualization != Evidence.
- [ ] UNKNOWN != retry permission.
- [ ] Observer/recovery side != omniscient backend.
- [ ] Concept != implemented artifact.
- [ ] First success != necessarily Healthy.
- [ ] Observe before expensive materialization.

## Evidence status

- [ ] story
- [ ] concept
- [ ] implemented artifact
- [ ] observed repository history

## Provenance

- [ ] I added/updated a `purrtocol-variant/v1` manifest.
- [ ] Parent lineage is accurate.
- [ ] Third-party asset licenses are documented.
- [ ] I am not using the variant art/animation as evidence for a production-system claim.

We welcome strange cats. We require legible provenance.
